description: This file defines a Java interface 'EmailConfigurationWritePlatformService' responsible for updating email configuration settings within the Fineract platform. It declares a single method 'update' that takes a JsonCommand and returns a CommandProcessingResult.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationWritePlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface for email configuration write operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates email configuration using the provided JsonCommand and returns the result as a CommandProcessingResult.
